authors_zh: Baixuan Fan、Maituo Feng、Panyuan Zhang、Tianshuo Peng、Shixun Li、Filei Jiang、Shawn Chen、Feng Pei、Sunliang Cai、Xiangyu Yue

ReAgent 探索用于智能体的推理奖励模型，并发布相应的奖励训练数据。

title: Problem
问题
html: Agentic reinforcement learning usually relies on sparse task-completion rewards, which cannot distinguish a promising intermediate plan from a flawed trajectory that fails only at the end. Outcome reward also provides little guidance about how to repair reasoning and tool use. The paper asks whether an agent reward model can produce structured process feedback—reasoning, critique, and score—and how different ways of injecting that feedback affect training across knowledge, web, and tool-using tasks.
Agent 强化学习通常依赖稀疏的任务完成奖励，无法区分有潜力的中间规划与直到终局才暴露错误的轨迹，也难以说明如何修复推理和工具使用。论文研究 agent 奖励模型能否同时输出结构化推理、针对性 critique 和总体过程分数，以及把这些反馈以不同方式注入训练后，会如何影响知识、网页和工具任务。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper introduces Agent-RRM, a multi-faceted reasoning reward model, and three integration strategies: Reagent-C uses textual critique for refinement, Reagent-R uses scalar reward guidance, and Reagent-U unifies both. Released training data contains agent trajectories with generated reasoning, critiques, and scores, including Reagent-RRM-RL-90K. The contribution is a structured feedback contract for agent trajectories rather than a single terminal label, enabling both language-level correction and reward-based reinforcement learning.

论文提出多面向 reasoning reward model——Agent-RRM，并设计三种集成方式：Reagent-C 使用文本 critique 修订，Reagent-R 使用标量奖励引导，Reagent-U 统一两者。开放数据包含 agent 轨迹、生成推理、批评与分数，其中包括 Reagent-RRM-RL-90K。其贡献是为 agent 轨迹建立结构化反馈契约，而非只给终局标签，使语言级纠正和基于奖励的强化学习能够共同使用。

title: Method
方法
html: Agent trajectories are collected across diverse tasks and paired with assessments of intermediate reasoning and tool decisions. Agent-RRM is trained to generate an explicit analysis, a focused critique identifying the main flaw or improvement, and an overall score. Reagent-C appends critique to support a revised attempt; Reagent-R converts scores into optimization guidance; Reagent-U combines the textual and scalar channels during agentic RL. The authors train and evaluate agents across twelve benchmarks, comparing sparse outcome reward and the three integration strategies.

流程先从多类任务收集 agent 轨迹，并对中间推理和工具决策生成评价。Agent-RRM 被训练为输出显式分析、指出主要缺陷或改进方向的聚焦 critique，以及总体分数。Reagent-C 把 critique 加入上下文以支持重新尝试；Reagent-R 将分数转成优化信号；Reagent-U 在 agentic RL 中同时融合文本与标量反馈。作者在十二个 benchmark 上训练和评测，并与稀疏结果奖励及三种集成方式比较。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper tests the framework on twelve benchmarks rather than one agent environment and directly compares critique-only, reward-only, unified feedback, and outcome-based training. Reagent-U reaches 43.7% on GAIA and 46.2% on WebWalkerQA, with broad improvements indicating that the two feedback channels are complementary. Releasing code, models, and datasets supports replication. The evidence shows useful structured supervision in the tested agent stack, but learned critiques and scores may share judge biases and do not constitute environment-grounded correctness by themselves.

论文在十二个 benchmark 上测试，而非只使用一个 agent 环境，并直接比较仅 critique、仅奖励、统一反馈和结果奖励训练。Reagent-U 在 GAIA 达到 43.7%，在 WebWalkerQA 达到 46.2%，且多个任务均有提升，说明文本与标量反馈具有互补性。代码、模型和数据开放支持复现。证据说明结构化监督在所测 agent 技术栈中有效，但学习得到的 critique 与分数可能共享 judge 偏差，本身不能等同于环境验证的正确性。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier agent reward models generally output one scalar or binary outcome, while self-refinement methods generate text critiques without integrating them into RL reward. Agent-RRM changes the feedback object to a three-part record: reasoning trace, focused critique, and overall score. Reagent-U then tests a unified consumption mechanism. The novelty is not generative judging or reinforcement learning separately, but the explicit multi-channel contract and systematic comparison of how each channel changes agent learning.
以往 agent 奖励模型通常输出单一标量或二元结果，自修订方法则生成文本 critique，却不一定把它整合进 RL 奖励。Agent-RRM 将反馈对象改为三部分记录：推理分析、聚焦批评和总体分数，Reagent-U 再统一消费这些信号。其新意不是生成式评判或强化学习本身，而是显式多通道反馈契约，以及系统比较各通道如何影响 agent 学习。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Generated critiques can be fluent but incorrect, and a shared reward model may reinforce its own preferred reasoning style. Overall scores can be poorly calibrated across task types, while text critiques may expose answer information or increase context cost. Twelve benchmarks broaden coverage but still use specific tools and environments. Reuse should separately evaluate critique factuality, score calibration, tool-grounded outcomes, and failure cases where the agent follows an incorrect critique. Environment verifiers should remain primary whenever available.

生成 critique 可能表达流畅却事实错误，共享奖励模型还可能强化自身偏好的推理风格。总体分数在不同任务间可能校准不佳，文本 critique 也可能泄露答案或增加上下文成本。十二个 benchmark 扩大了覆盖，但仍绑定特定工具和环境。复用时应分别评测 critique 事实性、分数校准、工具执行结果，以及 agent 遵循错误 critique 的失败案例；存在环境 verifier 时仍应以其为主要依据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The released trajectory–critique–score records can train agent critics, generative verifiers, or process reward models. Reagent-C is useful when a system can afford a second attempt, Reagent-R when training requires a compact scalar, and Reagent-U when both channels are available. Researchers can use the dataset to compare outcome, process, and textual feedback under one agent base. The method is less appropriate for tasks where critiques cannot be verified and mistakes could trigger irreversible real-world actions.

开放的“轨迹—critique—分数”记录可用于训练 agent critic、生成式 verifier 或过程奖励模型。Reagent-C 适合能够进行第二次尝试的系统，Reagent-R 适合训练需要紧凑标量信号的场景，Reagent-U 则用于两种通道均可获得时。研究者可在同一 agent 基础上比较结果、过程和文本反馈。当 critique 无法验证且错误可能触发不可逆真实操作时，不宜直接采用该方法。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Agent-RRM produces three feedback surfaces: analysis, focused critique, and score. Reagent-C consumes text, Reagent-R consumes reward, and Reagent-U combines both. Evaluation spans twelve benchmarks; Reagent-U reaches 43.7% on GAIA and 46.2% on WebWalkerQA, providing the main evidence for complementarity. The largest risk is shared judge error across critique and score. Reuse should keep environment success checks separate and measure whether critiques are correct before using them as training targets.

Agent-RRM 输出分析、聚焦 critique 和分数三种反馈表面；Reagent-C 消费文本，Reagent-R 消费奖励，Reagent-U 统一两者。评测覆盖十二个 benchmark，Reagent-U 在 GAIA 达到 43.7%，在 WebWalkerQA 达到 46.2%，这是两类反馈互补的主要证据。最大风险是 critique 与分数共享 judge 错误。复用时应保留独立环境成功检查，并先测量 critique 正确性再将其作为训练目标。
